title_en: The Game That Escaped the Soviet Union
title_zh: 走出苏联的俄罗斯方块
english_paragraphs: In June 1984 Alexey Pajitnov, a 29-year-old Moscow coder, grew engrossed in a diversion he had built. His primitive Elektronika 60 had a purely textual display, so every geometric piece of four tiles was assembled from characters. The result proved addictive. He called it Tetris, a fusion of the Greek tetra- and tennis, his favourite pastime.

In the Soviet Union, the state, not its salaried designer, was the proprietor of this intellectual property, and Pajitnov held no entitlement to it. Copies mushroomed freely on floppy disks across the Eastern bloc.

In 1986 Robert Stein, an enterprising British software vendor, stumbled upon Tetris in Hungary. In his ignorance of Elorg, the state bureau regulating Soviet software exports, he hastily hawked rights he did not yet legitimately hold. The rights were shuffled onward through a chaotic muddle of overlapping deals among Western firms, one owned by the magnate Robert Maxwell.

In February 1989 Henk Rogers, a resourceful Dutch-born publisher, reached Moscow on a tourist visa and found his way to Elorg. Stein and Kevin Maxwell, the magnate's son, were in Moscow that same hectic week of negotiations, each a bidder. Pajitnov felt a fondness for Rogers, and Nintendo scooped the handheld rights, then worldwide console rights.

Nintendo bundled Tetris with its pocket-sized Game Boy, and that version shipped over 35 million copies. Pajitnov reaped none of the spoils for years. His earnings began only after his arrangement's expiry around 1995. In 1996 he and Rogers founded The Tetris Company to manage the rights.
The man whose puzzle once spread for nothing later helped decide who could sell it.
chinese_source_paragraphs: 1984年6月，阿列克谢·帕基特诺夫，一位29岁的**莫斯科**(Moscow)**程序员**(coder)，渐渐变得**全神贯注于**(engrossed in)一个他自己此前编写出来的**消遣（游戏）**(diversion)。他那台**简陋的**(primitive)Elektronika 60只有一块**纯粹地**(purely)**文本的**(textual)显示屏，所以每一个**几何**(geometric)方块，由四个**小格**(tiles)组成的，都是**由**(assembled from)**字符**(characters)**拼装而成的**(assembled from)。结果，这个游戏**让人上瘾**(addictive)。他给它取名 **Tetris（俄罗斯方块）**(Tetris)，这是**希腊语**(Greek)前缀 tetra- 和网球 tennis 的**融合**(fusion)，网球是他最爱的**消遣**(pastime)运动。

在前苏联，国家，而不是领**工资的**(salaried)**设计者**(designer)，是这份**知识产权**(intellectual property)的**所有者**(proprietor)，而帕基特诺夫对它没有任何**权利**(entitlement)。盗版复制品**不受限制地**(freely)**如蘑菇般迅速涌现**(mushroomed)，靠**软盘**(floppy disks)遍及整个**东欧集团**(Eastern bloc)。

1986年，罗伯特·斯坦因，一位**富有进取心的**(enterprising)英国**软件**(software)**商人**(vendor)，在**匈牙利**(Hungary)**偶然碰到了**(stumbled upon)**俄罗斯方块**(Tetris)。由于他**对**(in ignorance of) Elorg **毫不知情**(in ignorance of)，那是一个**国家机关**(state bureau)，**监管**(regulating)着苏联**软件**(software)出口，他就**草率地**(hastily)**兜售**(hawked)起他尚未**合法**(legitimately)拥有的版权。这些版权在**混乱的**(chaotic)**一团糟**(muddle)中，被**持续地**(onward)**洗牌式地来回倒手**(shuffled)，因为由西方公司之间**重叠的**(overlapping)交易而导致了这种情况，其中一家公司归**大亨**(magnate)罗伯特·马克斯韦尔所有。

1989年2月，亨克·罗杰斯，一位**足智多谋的**(resourceful)荷兰裔**发行商**(publisher)，持旅游**签证**(visa)来到**莫斯科**(Moscow)，**设法找到了**(found his way to) Elorg。斯坦因和凯文·马克斯韦尔，那位大亨的儿子，都在**莫斯科**(Moscow)，就在同一个**忙乱的**(hectic)**谈判**(negotiations)周里，各自都是版权的**竞标者**(bidder)。帕基特诺夫对罗杰斯颇有**好感**(fondness)，**任天堂**(Nintendo)**抢得/抢下了**(scooped)掌机版权，后来又拿下了全球**游戏主机**(console)版权。

**任天堂**(Nintendo)把**俄罗斯方块**(Tetris)和它那款**口袋大小的**(pocket-sized) Game Boy **捆绑**(bundled)销售，这个**版本**(version)出货超过3,500万份。帕基特诺夫**收获**(reaped)不到一点那些**战利品**(spoils)（即收益），多年来始终如此。直到1995年前后他的**协议**(arrangement)**到期**(expiry)之后，他才开始有**收入**(earnings)。1996年，他和罗杰斯**成立/创办了**(founded)俄罗斯方块公司，来管理这些版权。
他的**益智游戏**(puzzle)曾无偿流布天下，多年后，他却成了决定谁能售卖它的人。

sentences.chinese_source: 他那台**简陋的**(primitive)Elektronika 60只有一块**纯粹地**(purely)**文本的**(textual)显示屏，所以每一个**几何**(geometric)方块，由四个**小格**(tiles)组成的，都是**由**(assembled from)**字符**(characters)**拼装而成的**(assembled from)。
结果，这个游戏**让人上瘾**(addictive)。

sentences.english: He called it Tetris, a fusion of the Greek tetra- and tennis, his favourite pastime.
sentences.chinese_source: 他给它取名 **Tetris（俄罗斯方块）**(Tetris)，这是**希腊语**(Greek)前缀 tetra- 和网球 tennis 的**融合**(fusion)，网球是他最爱的**消遣**(pastime)运动。

sentences.english: In the Soviet Union, the state, not its salaried designer, was the proprietor of this intellectual property, and Pajitnov held no entitlement to it.
sentences.chinese_source: 在前苏联，国家，而不是领**工资的**(salaried)**设计者**(designer)，是这份**知识产权**(intellectual property)的**所有者**(proprietor)，而帕基特诺夫对它没有任何**权利**(entitlement)。

sentences.english: Copies mushroomed freely on floppy disks across the Eastern bloc.
sentences.chinese_source: 盗版复制品**不受限制地**(freely)**如蘑菇般迅速涌现**(mushroomed)，靠**软盘**(floppy disks)遍及整个**东欧集团**(Eastern bloc)。

sentences.english: In 1986 Robert Stein, an enterprising British software vendor, stumbled upon Tetris in Hungary.
sentences.chinese_source: 1986年，罗伯特·斯坦因，一位**富有进取心的**(enterprising)英国**软件**(software)**商人**(vendor)，在**匈牙利**(Hungary)**偶然碰到了**(stumbled upon)**俄罗斯方块**(Tetris)。

sentences.english: In his ignorance of Elorg, the state bureau regulating Soviet software exports, he hastily hawked rights he did not yet legitimately hold.
sentences.chinese_source: 由于他**对**(in ignorance of) Elorg **毫不知情**(in ignorance of)，那是一个**国家机关**(state bureau)，**监管**(regulating)着苏联**软件**(software)出口，他就**草率地**(hastily)**兜售**(hawked)起他尚未**合法**(legitimately)拥有的版权。

sentences.english: The rights were shuffled onward through a chaotic muddle of overlapping deals among Western firms, one owned by the magnate Robert Maxwell.
sentences.chinese_source: 这些版权在**混乱的**(chaotic)**一团糟**(muddle)中，被**持续地**(onward)**洗牌式地来回倒手**(shuffled)，因为由西方公司之间**重叠的**(overlapping)交易而导致了这种情况，其中一家公司归**大亨**(magnate)罗伯特·马克斯韦尔所有。

sentences.english: In February 1989 Henk Rogers, a resourceful Dutch-born publisher, reached Moscow on a tourist visa and found his way to Elorg.
sentences.chinese_source: 1989年2月，亨克·罗杰斯，一位**足智多谋的**(resourceful)荷兰裔**发行商**(publisher)，持旅游**签证**(visa)来到**莫斯科**(Moscow)，**设法找到了**(found his way to) Elorg。

sentences.english: Stein and Kevin Maxwell, the magnate's son, were in Moscow that same hectic week of negotiations, each a bidder.
sentences.chinese_source: 斯坦因和凯文·马克斯韦尔，那位大亨的儿子，都在**莫斯科**(Moscow)，就在同一个**忙乱的**(hectic)**谈判**(negotiations)周里，各自都是版权的**竞标者**(bidder)。

sentences.english: Pajitnov felt a fondness for Rogers, and Nintendo scooped the handheld rights, then worldwide console rights.
sentences.chinese_source: 帕基特诺夫对罗杰斯颇有**好感**(fondness)，**任天堂**(Nintendo)**抢得/抢下了**(scooped)掌机版权，后来又拿下了全球**游戏主机**(console)版权。

sentences.english: Nintendo bundled Tetris with its pocket-sized Game Boy, and that version shipped over 35 million copies.
sentences.chinese_source: **任天堂**(Nintendo)把**俄罗斯方块**(Tetris)和它那款**口袋大小的**(pocket-sized) Game Boy **捆绑**(bundled)销售，这个**版本**(version)出货超过3,500万份。

sentences.english: Pajitnov reaped none of the spoils for years.
sentences.chinese_source: 帕基特诺夫**收获**(reaped)不到一点那些**战利品**(spoils)（即收益），多年来始终如此。

sentences.english: His earnings began only after his arrangement's expiry around 1995.
sentences.chinese_source: 直到1995年前后他的**协议**(arrangement)**到期**(expiry)之后，他才开始有**收入**(earnings)。

sentences.english: In 1996 he and Rogers founded The Tetris Company to manage the rights.
sentences.chinese_source: 1996年，他和罗杰斯**成立/创办了**(founded)俄罗斯方块公司，来管理这些版权。

sentences.english: The man whose puzzle once spread for nothing later helped decide who could sell it.
sentences.chinese_source: 他的**益智游戏**(puzzle)曾无偿流布天下，多年后，他却成了决定谁能售卖它的人。

approved_summary: 1984年，苏联程序员帕基特诺夫在只能显示文字的电脑上，用字符做出了俄罗斯方块。
游戏版权属于苏联国家，作者没有支配权，复制品则通过软盘在东欧集团迅速流传。
英国软件商斯坦因不知Elorg掌管苏联软件出口，未获授权就转卖版权，造成西方公司权利重叠。
1989年，发行商罗杰斯找到Elorg谈判，任天堂获掌机及全球主机版权，Game Boy版出货3500多万份。
帕基特诺夫到约1995年旧协议到期才开始获得游戏收益；1996年与罗杰斯成立公司，参与管理版权。
